name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport

slots.v: non-scheduled operators must file a slot request with the airport operations control centre (AOCC); all non-scheduled and general aviation movements need positive approval
slots.quote: Non Scheduled Aircraft operators are required to file their slot request with aocc.planning@adani.com for clearance.

ppr.v: requests for international movements at least 72 hours ahead, domestic at least 12 hours ahead
ppr.quote: Request for International movement must be forwarded at least 72hrs in advance.

handling.v: hangar space at Air India and Jet Airways hangars subject to availability; no handling agents named
handling.quote: At Air India (NACIL) and Jet Airways Hanger subject to availability.
